title: Solution Architect &#8211; Ecosystems APAC
description:
GitLab is an open-core software company that develops the most comprehensive AI-powered DevSecOps Platform, used by more than 100,000 organizations. Our mission is to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world. When everyone can contribute, consumers become contributors, significantly accelerating human progress. Our platform unites teams and organizations, breaking down barriers and redefining what’s possible in software development. Thanks to products like Duo Enterprise and Duo Agent Platform, customers get AI benefits at every stage of the SDLC. 

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

An overview of this role

As an Ecosystem Solutions Architect, you’ll be a trusted advisor to our partners, helping them understand how GitLab’s DevSecOps platform can power differentiated solutions, drive services-led growth, and generate repeatable, partner-sourced revenue. You’ll own the technical side of the partner activation journey, from discovery and capability assessment through joint solution design, enablement, and go-to-market execution, guiding partners as they build, package, and sell GitLab-based offerings. You’ll work closely with Ecosystem Sales Managers, Strategic Alliance leaders, Partner Enablement, and Product and Sales teams to turn partner awareness into active engagement and, ultimately, into partners leading high-value activities with GitLab. In your first year, you’ll focus on building deep technical relationships with priority partners, co-creating activation plans that grow their GitLab practices, and becoming the go-to technical advocate for GitLab across our partner ecosystem.

Some examples of our projects:

  • Creating and executing Partner Activation Plans that define capability goals, activation tactics, timelines, and measurable outcomes across contribution, commitment, and capability
  • Co-designing partner solutions, service offerings, and technical artifacts (for example, demos, labs, integrations, and collateral) that showcase GitLab-based workflows and support joint go-to-market motions

What you’ll do

  • Engage with partners across priority regions, onsite and remotely, to provide technical expertise and guidance that accelerates their GitLab practice growth and joint customer impact
  • Collaborate with Ecosystem Sales Managers and partner sales leaders to shape and execute Partner Activation Plans that drive partner-sourced pipeline and GitLab adoption
  • Own the technical aspects of partner activation, including building and delivering demos, reference architectures, and workshops that support contribution, commitment, and capability activation
  • Serve as the Directly Responsible Individual on partner technical activation plans, ensuring technical risks and gaps are identified, addressed, and aligned to mutual GitLab, partner, and customer outcomes
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with technical and business stakeholders at partners so they progress from awareness to actively leading high-value activities like deal registrations and solution development
  • Act as the partner advocate to internal teams by sharing field feedback and insights with Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Partner Enablement to influence roadmap and programs
  • Maintain and deepen your expertise in GitLab and partner technologies through training, certifications, and the creation of reusable technical artifacts such as integrations, solution blueprints, and lab content
  • Enable partners on the value of the GitLab platform, modern software development and DevSecOps practices, continuous integration and continuous deployment, and how to position these with their customers
  • Support partner-led assessments and service offerings that uncover opportunities for GitLab-based solutions, expanded partner services, and scalable customer implementations

What you’ll bring

  • Experience working with or for technology partners, system integrators, cloud providers, or channel ecosystems, and the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical partner stakeholders
  • Background in technical pre-sales, solution consulting, partner engineering, or information technology roles where you have supported a sales cycle or partner-led customer adoption journey
  • Experience with modern software development or operations practices and related technologies, including version control, continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD), and cloud-based environments
  • Understanding of the end-to-end software development lifecycle and how DevSecOps practices support business outcomes, including the ability to translate these into partner use cases, joint solutions, and service offerings
  • Ability to design and present partner-focused technical solutions that address market and customer requirements, including building and enabling demos, running workshops, and supporting proofs of concept or value in partnership with GitLab and partners
  • Skill in building trusted relationships with partner technical and business leaders, and representing partner and joint-customer needs back to GitLab Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Partner teams
  • Ability to work independently in a remote, distributed team, manage multiple partner priorities and activation plans, and adapt to different partner types, regions, and industry verticals
  • Openness to learning new technologies and approaches, with interest in applying transferable skills to the GitLab platform and its ecosystem, including co-creating technical artifacts, integrations, and enablement content with partners

About the team

Our Ecosystem Solutions Architect team partners with Ecosystem Sales to help partners across regions understand, adopt, and build differentiated offerings on the GitLab DevSecOps platform. You’ll join a collaborative global group that works closely with Ecosystem Sales Managers, Strategic Alliance leaders, Partner Enablement, and Services teams to activate partners across contribution, commitment, and capability, while reporting into Ecosystem leadership. The team works in an all-remote, highly asynchronous way across time zones, combining deep technical expertise with consultative engagement to guide partners through technical activation plans, solution development, and joint go-to-market initiatives. Current priorities include scaling Partner Activation Plans for key partners, transitioning partners from passive awareness to leading high-value activities like partner-sourced revenue and solution development, and sharing partner and market feedback with Product, Engineering, and Marketing to shape GitLab’s ecosystem strategy and improve outcomes for GitLab, partners, and customers.

How GitLab will support you

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off 
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental leave 
  • Home office support

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you’re excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

title: Senior Civil Substation Engineer (Bucharest/ Remote from Romania)
description:
Company Description

AECOM’s Enterprise Capabilities team is looking for a Senior Civil Substation Engineer to join our team in Bucharest, Romania.

About Enterprise Capabilities

Fundamental to our Think and Act Globally strategy and digital adoption, Enterprise Capabilities (EC) is AECOM’s primary vehicle for workshare. Operating across geographic boundaries and time-zones, EC partners with regional and Global Business Line project teams to provide technical expertise, accelerate delivery and keep AECOM competitive in the industry. 

With a team of over 3000 technical professionals located across nine countries and remote technical anchors, EC teams are trusted to deliver high-quality, specialist services that help to fill capability gaps, resourcing needs and technical constraints on projects of all scopes and sizes.

Start here. Grow here.

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Civil Substation Engineer to lead the design, analysis, and delivery of civil works supporting high-voltage substations up to 400 kV. This role focuses on the civil engineering aspects of substation infrastructure, including site development, earthworks, access roads, drainage, grading, paving, fencing, and foundation interfaces.

The ideal candidate brings extensive experience in substation civil engineering and is proficient in AutoCAD or MicroStation for detailed design and drawing development. The position requires the ability to manage complete civil design packages, provide mentorship, and collaborate with structural and electrical disciplines to deliver safe, efficient, and constructible substation civil designs for both greenfield and brownfield projects.

This opportunity is open to candidates based in Bucharest (hybrid working model: 50% from the office and 50% from home), as well as candidates located in other cities in Romania (fully remote). We also welcome applications from candidates based in other countries; in this case, relocation to Bucharest is required to follow the hybrid working model, and visa and relocation support may be provided for suitable candidates.

Job Description

Here is what you will do:

1. Civil Design & Site Development

  • Lead the design of site grading, earthworks, roads, drainage, fencing, and pavement layouts for substations up to 400 kV.

  • Perform stormwater management, and erosion control design in compliance with local and international standards.

  • Develop civil drawings including site layouts, grading plans, drainage layouts, road details, and civil general arrangements using AutoCAD and MicroStation.

  • Coordinate foundation interface details for major electrical equipment such as transformers, GIS/AIS equipments, and control buildings.

  • Integrate civil design with structural, electrical, and geotechnical inputs, ensuring full alignment with substation layout requirements and site constraints.

2. Leadership & Project Management

  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to civil engineers and CAD designers.

  • Manage project deliverables, schedules, and budgets for civil engineering scopes of work.

  • Support tendering, cost estimation, and proposal preparation for civil engineering packages.

  • Represent the civil engineering discipline in client meetings, design reviews, and coordination workshops.

3. Construction & Field Support

  • Provide technical support during construction, RFI responses, and review of contractor submissions.

  • Conduct constructability and feasibility reviews to ensure civil designs are practical, safe, and cost-effective.

  • Support inspection, testing, and as-built verification of civil works.

  • Liaise with contractors, site supervisors, and project managers to ensure design intent is met.

4. Documentation & Quality Assurance

  • Prepare and review civil calculation reports, bills of quantities, material specifications, and construction documentation.

  • Ensure all designs comply with company QA/QC procedures, client standards, and safety regulations.

  • Participate in peer reviews, interdisciplinary coordination, and internal audits to maintain high-quality deliverables.

5. Innovation & Standards Development

  • Assess and integrate new design methods, software tools, and sustainable materials to improve efficiency and environmental performance.

  • Stay updated with industry standards, regulations, and best practices in civil substation engineering.

Qualifications

Here’s what we’re looking for:

Required:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Civil Engineering (or related discipline).

  • Minimum 6+ years of experience in civil design for HV/MV substations (up to 400 kV preferred).

  • Proven experience with site grading, drainage, roads, earthworks, and substation layout development.

  • Proficiency in AutoCAD or MicroStation for civil design and detailing.

  • Strong knowledge of international civil and design standards (IEC, BS, Eurocodes, IEEE, ANSI etc.).

  • Solid understanding of substation site planning, access requirements, and integration with electrical layouts.

Preferred:

  • Experience with construction supervision, site inspection, and commissioning support.

  • Knowledge of hydrological analysis tools, stormwater modeling, or civil 3D/BIM software.

  • Experience in GIS or AIS substation developments.

  • Familiarity with major utility or transmission operator standards.

  • Professional Engineer (PE) status

Soft Skills:

  • Strong leadership and mentoring abilities.

  • Excellent communication and coordination skills with multidisciplinary teams.

  • Highly organized and adaptable, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

  • Committed to quality, safety, and continuous improvement.

Additional Information

At AECOM, you will have freedom to grow in a world of opportunity

description:

Founded in 2013, Housecall Pro helps home service professionals (Pros) streamline every aspect of their business. With easy-to-use tools for scheduling, dispatching, payments, and more, Housecall Pro enables Pros to save time, grow profitably, and provide best-in-class service.

Housecall Pro’s brand portfolio includes BuildBook, construction management software for builders and remodelers, and CONQUER, a business coaching solution for home services businesses. We support more than 45,000 businesses and have over 1,500 ambitious, mission-driven, genuinely fun-loving employees across the United States and worldwide (including Poland ). 

Housecall Pro celebrates diversity and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on gender, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, disability, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other category protected under the law. If you want to do work that impacts real people, supported by a team that will invest in you every step of the way, we’d love to hear from you.

>>>Learn more about the Polish Team at Housecall Pro<<<

Role Overview:

As a Fullstack Engineer II, you specialize in building performant, intuitive front-end experiences using React and bring hands-on experience with backend development to support the full lifecycle of product features. You thrive in a collaborative, agile environment and partner closely with other engineers, product managers, and designers to drive solutions that deliver real impact to our customers. You are motivated by clean code, continuous learning, and the opportunity to improve the lives of our service professionals through technology.

Our team is passionate, empathetic, hard working, and above all else focused on improving the lives of our service professionals (our Pros). Our success is their success.

Compensation: 4,500 – 6,000 USD per month

We also offer:

  • Paid time off
  • Flexible work hours
  • 100% remote work
  • Equity shares in a rapidly growing company backed by top-tier VCs
  • A culture built on innovation that values big ideas
  • We work in Central European Time
  • Newest MacBook + Setup Fee ($500)

Joining Housecall Pro means:

  • Building a product that improves users’ lives (70k users, 4.6 rates at App Store)
  • Being a part of the Polish team of engineers, who put the highest priority on the quality and safety of technical solutions
  • Working with a mature, interdisciplinary dev team (almost 100% of the Polish squad are seniors);
  • Having a real impact on technical decisions;
  • Being in direct contact with the community of users, who are eager to share their feedback;
  • You are committed to your work, open to feedback, and eager to share your knowledge, just like us

What you do each day:

  • Develop and maintain React-based features and interfaces aligned with product initiatives
  • Implement and extend backend functionality using the Ruby on Rails framework to support frontend requirements
  • Participate in the full software development lifecycle, from design through deployment
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with designers and product managers to deliver user-focused solutions
  • Write clean, maintainable code with test coverage (unit, integration)
  • Participate in code reviews to ensure adherence to best practices and architectural standards
  • Debug and resolve bugs, performance issues, and integration challenges
  • Contribute to improvements in team development processes and workflows
  • Work with RESTful APIs to ensure reliable and consistent data communication
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and advocate for relevant adoption

Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of professional experience with React.js
  • Minimum 1 year of experience working on backend development (i.e. Ruby on Rails, Python, Go, Elixir, Node.js, etc.)
  • Solid understanding of software development principles, including OOP and RESTful architecture
  • Experience writing unit and integration tests
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent work experience

What will help you succeed in this role:

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Adaptability in a fast-paced, agile development environment
  • Eagerness to grow technically and learn from peers
  • Customer-first mindset when making engineering decisions
  • Proactive approach to problem-solving and continuous improvement

How we work

Our primary backend technology stack at HCP is Ruby. To be effective in this role, you’ll need to learn it. We offer support in the learning process, tailored to your needs and any prior experience with Ruby. This may include mentoring from our experienced engineering team or access to a paid online course that you can complete during working hours as part of your onboarding. title: Airbus Atlantic - Architecte Industriel (All Gender)
description:
**Job Description:**

**Et si VOTRE aventure avec NOUS commençait ?!**

Nous vous proposons de travailler chez Airbus Atlantic , champion mondial sur le marché des aérostructures, des sièges pilotes et des fauteuils passagers Première Classe et Classe Affaires. Nous innovons sans cesse pour définir de nouveaux standards d’excellence industrielle. Nous préparons le futur pour une industrie aérospatiale compétitive et durable.


Notre site Airbus Atlantic basé à Montoir de Bretagne recherche son futur: Architecte Industriel Pointe Avant du fuselage (All gender).


Ce poste est rattaché aux activités des Architectes Industriels au sein du département R\&T Fuselage. Les activités de R\&T (Recherche et Technologie) et de R\&D (Recherche et Développement) sont menées conjointement pour répondre aux ambitions du programme "Avion du Futur". Dans ce contexte, l'approche de co\-développement (Industrie et Produit) est un facteur clé de succès. Elle implique la coordination d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire regroupant de nombreuses compétences, disciplines et fonctions.


Ces activités sont également soutenues par des dispositifs de financement nationaux, tels que le CORAC (Comité pour la Recherche Aéronautique Civile).


L'équipe des Architectes Industriels Fuselage d'Airbus recherche un profil pour rejoindre l'équipe R\&T au sein du programme « Transport Payload ».


**Votre mission**

Votre rôle est de garantir que le concept industriel choisi est le plus performant possible (coût, qualité, cycle).


* **Conception du Système :** Vous définissez comment sera fabriqué le fuselage avant, des pièces élémentaires (métalliques et composites) jusqu'à l'assemblage final.
* **Maturation Technologique :** Vous pilotez les niveaux de maturité industrielle ( **MRL** ) et identifiez les besoins en démonstrateurs pour valider les nouvelles technologies.
* **Arbitrage Product/Process :** Vous challengez les exigences de conception pour assurer la fabricabilité et l'optimisation des coûts (analyse des *cost drivers* ).

**3\. Responsabilités et Livrables Clés**

Vous agissez comme le "chef d'orchestre" industriel sur votre périmètre :


* **Dossiers Techniques :** Rédaction de l' **IBD** (Industrial Baseline Dossier) et des fiches de tâches pour les projets subventionnés (NAMI 2\).
* **Performance :** Analyse des indicateurs de mérite ( **FoM** ) pour justifier les choix industriels.
* **Coordination :** Animation d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire (Engineering, Achats, Qualité, Finance) et suivi du budget alloué.
* **Interface Usine :** Lien direct avec les usines et les lignes d'assemblage ( **FAL** ) pour préparer l'industrialisation future.

**Parlons de vous !**

* **Expertise technique :** Connaissances approfondies des matériaux métalliques et composites, ainsi que de leurs processus de fabrication.
* **Assemblage :** Maîtrise de l'assemblage structurel aéronautique (MCA \- Major Component Assembly et FAL \- Final Assembly Line).
* **Expérience :** Expérience confirmée en planification d'usine, conception de lignes de production Lean et ingénierie système.
* **Outils :** Maîtrise de la gestion des exigences industrielles, ainsi que des logiciels **3DX (3DExperience)** et **Anylogic** .
* **Soft Skills :** Capacité de prise de décision, esprit d'équipe, aisance relationnelle avec des interlocuteurs variés et capacité à vulgariser des sujets techniques complexes.
* **Langues :** **Anglais courant impératif** . La maîtrise du français, de l'allemand ou de l'espagnol est un plus.

**Parlons de nous !**

Montoir : Le site Airbus Atlantic de Montoir\-de\-Bretagne, qualifié d’intégrateur ou de pré\-chaîne d’assemblage final, assemble, équipe et teste les fuselages avant et centraux de tous les avions Airbus hormis l’A220\. Véritable Hub Logistique d’Airbus Atlantic, le site livre ses “Major Component Assemblies” directement aux chaînes d’assemblage final Airbus de Toulouse, Hambourg, Mobile ou encore Tianjin, par Beluga ou bateau.


*Pour en savoir plus :* **vidéo**

**Environnement \& Conditions de travail :**

Airbus Atlantic c’est aussi :


* Prendre part à des projets ambitieux, à la pointe de la technologie pour construire l’avion de demain, en lien avec les enjeux environnementaux .
* Un environnement qui valorise la proximité et la dimension humaine, au sein d’un collectif engagé et solidaire .
* L’opportunité d’apprendre et d’évoluer tout au long de votre parcours, en étant accompagné dans votre développement pour une carrière sur\-mesure .
* Avoir la liberté d’ entreprendre et de laisser libre court à vos initiatives .
* Ses conditions de travail attractives et ses avantages : restaurant d’entreprise sur site, CSE (avantages loisirs \& famille), parking entreprise, mutuelle d’entreprise (famille).
* Sa politique de diversité et d'inclusion : Airbus Atlantic s’engage en faveur de l’égalité des chances pour tous.
* Son plan d'actionnariat salarié et son plan d’épargne salariale.

**Notre processus de recrutement :**

Nous avons à cœur de mieux vous connaître et de comprendre ce qui vous motive à nous rejoindre. Aussi, notre process de recrutement se déroule en plusieurs étapes après analyse de votre candidature :


* Entretien vidéo différé via la plateforme Hirevue.
* Entretien avec le Manager Recruteur.
* Entretien avec le Recruteur qui sera complété par un questionnaire de personnalité.

title: Chef de projet confirmé Ingénierie des Infrastructures urbaines et Transports Urbains H/F
description:
* **Design \& Engineering**
* **Permanent Contract**
* **Mid\-Senior Level**
* **Montpellier**

  
**About Us**

  

Egis est un **acteur international du conseil, de l'ingénierie de la construction et des services à la mobilité.**

**Présent dans 120 pays**, Egis met **l'expertise de ses 23 000 collaborateurs** au service de ses clients et développe des innovations de pointe à la portée de tous les projets.


Par la diversité de ses domaines d'intervention, le Groupe est un **acteur clé de l'organisation collective de la société et du cadre de vie des citoyens dans le monde entier.**

 **About the Role**

  

Pour accompagner le développement de notre **agence EGIS Villes et Transports basée à Montpellier (34\),** nous cherchons notre futur **Chef de projet confirmé H/F dans le domaine des infrastructures VRD \- aménagements / renouvellements urbains,**


Vous souhaitez **imaginer et concevoir la ville de demain,** être au cœur de la conception et de la réalisation de **projets urbains éco\-responsables, équilibrés et vertueux.**  

Vous êtes motivé à **construire la ville du futur au service des populations !**

  

Alors rejoignez **à Montpellier, les équipes EGIS de l'activité "Transport urbain \& Aménagement Urbain"**  



**L’agence de Montpellier**, est au cœur de la conception et de la réalisation des projets d'aménagements urbains et d'infrastructures majeurs sur l'ex territoire "Languedoc Roussillon". L'activité se positionne principalement sur **la maitrise d’œuvre complète de projets urbains** (renouvellement urbain NPNRU, voies vertes, plans cyclables, aménagements urbains, ZAC, écoquartiers...), **projets de transports urbains** (BHNS, Pôle d’échanges multimodaux...), **ainsi que de projets routiers pour les collectivités locales.** Elle de positionne également sur des missions technique d'assistante à maitrise d'ouvrage, sur des études amont et pré\-opérationnelle, ainsi que des missions d'OPC, OPC\-IC.

  

**A titre d’exemple,**l’agence mène actuellement les études et les travaux des opérations suivantes : NPNRU Mosson à Montpellier, ZAC Cité créative à Montpellier, ZAC Saint Roch à Montpellier, ZAC ODE à la mer à Lattes/Pérols, requalification de la ville balnéaire de Carnon et du centre ville historique de Frontignan, le parc Jacques Chirac à Nîmes, les plateformes portuaires à Port la nouvelle, le renouvellement de plateformes tramway existantes, le Bustram à Montpellier sur 3 lignes.

**En tant que chef de projet H/F** vos missions seront les suivantes :  

* Vous participerez activement à la conception technique du projet, aux études et au suivi des travaux
* Vous êtes l'interlocuteur privilégié du client en le conseillant et en l'accompagnant tout au long de la réalisation du projet
* Vous coordonnez les différents intervenants techniques internes et externes (les partenaires notamment les concepteurs, les sous\-traitants,...)
* Vous intervenez sur des missions de maîtrise d'œuvre ou des études pré\-opérationnelles / études amont, ou des missions d’assistance à maitrise d’ouvrage
* Vous pilotez les aspects contractuels des projets, y compris avenants, et êtes responsable du suivi financier de l'affaire, en tenant les objectifs budgétaires et plannings
* En appui au responsable d’agence, vous prenez en charge certains dossiers de réponses aux appels d'offres, et pourrez être amené à suivre le management de la production au sein de l’agence (suivi hebdomadaire et planification des équipes sur projets)
* Vous serez un appui technique, contractuel et financier aux chefs de projets et chargés d'études de l’agence,
* Vous prendrez en charge la direction des projets structurants de l'agence,
* Vous apporterez et transmettrez votre expérience aux collaborateurs "juniors" de l'équipe (projeteurs ou ingénieurs) en les encadrant et en les faisant monter en compétences.

 **What do we need from you**

  

Ingénieur généraliste ou à dominante génie civil, BTP, urbanisme **(INSA, ENTPE, EIVP, ESTP, UTC, HEI, ESIP, ENPC, ISABTP, ENI, ESI Reims, Polytech, ENGESS …) ou Master équivalent,** vous justifiez d'une expérience **confirmée de 10 ans à 15 ans,** dans le domaine des infrastructures et de l'aménagement urbain, idéalement en bureau d'études, afin de concevoir en toute autonomie les offres de services d’études ou d’ingénierie de l'agence et de coordonner la production des études techniques associées.  

* Manager à l’écoute, force de persuasion, vous appréciez le travail en équipe et instaurez un environnement favorisant l'adhésion et la réussite de vos collaborateurs et des prestataires externes (concepteurs, paysagistes, urbanistes...) en accord avec les valeurs humaines et de professionnalisme du groupe Egis. De plus, vous avez démontré des capacités à piloter et animer une équipe pluridisciplinaire d'étude et de maitrise d'oeuvre.
* Grâce à votre excellent relationnel, vos qualités rédactionnelles et votre aisance à l'oral, vous saurez créer une relation de confiance, à long terme, avec nos clients afin de développer l'action commerciale.
* Vous maitrisez les marchés publics, la loi MOP, le CCAG travaux, le CCAG PI, et avez une connaissance des procédures réglementaires de l'aménagement.
* Vous avez le sens du leadership, une rigueur dans la gestion contractuelle, technique et financière de vos projets, une appétence commerciale ou managériale affirmée, et vous aimez développer votre activité et mener vos projets et vos équipes vers la réussite et l'excellence.
* Vous savez faire preuve de rigueur technique, d'esprit d’analyse et de synthèse, de capacité d’organisation, de méthode, d'esprit d’équipe et d’initiative.
* Vous êtes moteur dans la conception d'ouvrages vertueux et êtes intéressé.e d'intervenir sur des projets complexes répondant aux enjeux actuels d'écoconception nécessaires à notre futur.
* Vous avez envie de contribuer à la conception durable et éco\-responsable des villes de demain.

Le plus : vous avez des compétences dans le domaine de l'hydraulique urbaine, des études règlementaires, des mobilités urbains et de système de transports urbains.

 **What's in it for you?**

  

En rejoignant notre groupe, nous vous proposons **une rémunération attractive,**  

* Salaire sur 13 mois \+ Primes (Primes Intéressement/Participation, Prime vacances..)
* Dispositif d'actionnariat
* RTT
* Télétravail selon l'accord entreprise.
* Mutuelle familiale d'entreprise, Carte restaurant...
* Divers avantages proposés par le CSE.


Nous offrons également des possibilités d**'évolution et de mobilité géographique au sein de nos 60 agences en France et dans nos 100 pays d'implantation à l'international.**  

**Si vous souhaitez apporter vos compétences techniques, vos savoir\-faire, votre curiosité et votre ouverture d'esprit pour intégrer notre équipe nous vous attendons !**

title: Senior Regulatory Affairs Program Manager (Koren speaking)
description:
**About Sonio**
===============


Each year, 140M children are born. Birth defects affect 1 in 33 births in developed countries, and in 50% of cases, they are not detected during prenatal examinations. Prenatal medicine is particularly complex, and the scans impose heavy responsibilities on healthcare professionals. They can also be a source of stress for future parents.


Resulting from 5 years of collaboration between world\-renowned experts from Necker Hospital and Ecole Polytechnique, Sonio uses artificial intelligence to improve prenatal screening and diagnosis. Based on patented algorithms and a proprietary expert database, Sonio aims to become the reference tool to help practitioners improve screening, reduce diagnostic errors, and optimize pregnant women’s medical path.


Sonio's mission is to improve women's and children's health by promoting access and quality of care through technological innovation, medical expertise, and collective intelligence.

**About the role**


You’ll join a newly created team that will work on synergy projects between Sonio and Samsung. You’ll work on advanced technological projects mixing both hardware and software with cutting\-edge AI/ML.


You will be responsible for developing and executing robust regulatory strategies, preparing high\-quality submissions, and serving as the primary liaison with regulatory bodies like the FDA to ensure our innovative products meet all requirements for global market entry and sustained compliance.


Key Responsibilities:

* Develop and implement comprehensive regulatory strategies for AI/ML\-enabled medical devices to ensure timely and successful market access.
* Prepare, compile, and submit high\-quality premarket submission files (e.g., 510(k)).
* Serve as the subject matter expert on FDA regulations and guidance pertinent to AI/ML and software\-based medical devices.
* Act as a primary liaison with the FDA and other regulatory bodies, managing communications and leading negotiations.
* Monitor the regulatory environment for changes related to SaMD and cybersecurity and assess their impact.

**Localisation**


You’ll be initially working in Paris or Boston, reporting to the Director of RAQA at Sonio, with Regular travel to Samsung HQ in Korea. After two years, you’ll move to Seoul, Korea, full\-time, joining the Samsung organisation as an internal expert on Regulatory affairs for AI/ML medical devices.

**About the profile**


Sonio is a mission\-driven company, so interest in our mission is critical. Other requirements are:

* Bachelor's degree in a scientific, engineering, or related discipline.
* 6\+ years of regulatory affairs experience within the medical device industry.
* Demonstrated experience preparing and managing FDA submissions for software\-based medical devices.
* In\-depth knowledge of FDA guidance, risk management (ISO 14971\), and quality management systems (ISO 13485, 21 CFR 820\).
* Strong understanding of the Total Product Life Cycle (TPLC) for medical devices.
* Excellent written/verbal communication and project management skills.

description:

---------------


Growing our Everyday Essentials business is a strategic priority for Amazon. EU Grocery is at the forefront of this mission, enabling customers to find the food and drink items they love at great prices and convenience.  

  

We are looking for someone passionate about fast moving consumer goods to join our team as a Sr. Vendor Manager, and drive the growth of our Grocery business across the EU.  

  

Although Paris is preferred \- this position can be based in any of the Amazon EU Retail locations \- London, Manchester, Milan, Madrid, Munich.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

The successful candidate must be able to:  

* Manage vendor relationships, negotiating to improve terms, solve problems, and oversee the day to day running of key accounts
* Conduct financial analysis of business opportunities to meet and exceed revenue and profitability targets
* Build a thorough understanding of the industry, seasonality and global trends/events, and continually monitor competitor/industry developments
* Work cross\-functionally with counterparts across strategic supply chain management, marketing, finance, Ads, Amazon programs, and retail systems to operate and grow the business
* Concisely represent your business to senior Amazon leaders through reporting, business reviews, financial planning sessions, and escalations
* Continually improve and automate manual processes to enable you and your team to scale as the business grows

  

The EU Grocery team manages one of the fastest growing areas of EU Stores, and is front and centre of Amazon's investment into Everyday Essentials. You will be managing vendor relationships across Europe as part of the wider EU Grocery vendor management team. Vendor managers also take on SME roles that will give you exposure across stakeholders across the stores business, and with Amazon Fresh as we develop our Grocery proposition across channels.  

  

Grocery is very much a non\-playbook GL where you will have opportunities to challenge tenets and established ways of working as we build a business to compete in a unique and high profile market segment.  

  

If you find the role intriguing, we encourage you to connect with the hiring manager and arrange a 'coffee chat.' This informal meeting provides an opportunity for you to express your interest, as well as gain deeper insights into the position.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Fluent written and verbal communication in English. French, Italian or Spanish are nice to have.
* Experience negotiating with internal and external stakeholders
* Experience with data analysis and P\&L ownership
* Experience using data to influence business decisions
* Experience driving internal cross\-team collaboration

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Bachelor’s/Master's degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Statistics, Marketing, Finance, Engineering or Management
* Experience in account management, project/program management, or buying
* Experience presenting to senior leadership
* Negotiations, analytical, vendor and/or project management experience
* Proficiency with Excel and database work, with experience in SQL as a plus

title: HR Manager
description:

Oerlikon Luxury, avec ses sites de production français situés à Maîche et Mamirolle (près de Besançon), propose une belle opportunité de poste de Responsable RH.

  

Oerlikon Luxury with its French production sites in Maiche and Mamirolle (Near Besancon), is offering an interesting HR Manager opportunity.

  

Êtes\-vous passionné(e) par un rôle RH ayant un réel impact ? Chez Oerlikon, nous recherchons un(e) Responsable RH dynamique pour rejoindre notre équipe et faire la différence. Si vous souhaitez travailler au sein d’une entreprise internationale avec une présence locale marquée, et si vous êtes orienté(e) changement et transformation, ce poste est fait pour vous.

  

Are you passionate about living an impactful HR Manager role? At Oerlikon, we’re looking for a dynamic HR Manager to join our team and make a real impact. If you are interested in working in an international company with local footprints and are close to a change and transformation mindest, this role will offer it.

 **Vos responsablités / Your responsibilities**

* **Être un véritable business partner** : collaborer et travailler avec les managers, les employés et l’ensemble des parties prenantes (CSE, organismes externes) pour gérer tous les aspects du cycle de vie du collaborateur, du recrutement et de l’intégration au développement et à la fidélisation, pour une population d’environ 100 employés.
* **Conduire le changement** : accompagner la croissance organisationnelle, la planification des effectifs et les initiatives de conduite du changement.
* **Valoriser les talents** : attirer, sélectionner et intégrer les talents afin de garantir une main\-d’œuvre performante.
* **Façonner la culture** : promouvoir un environnement de travail positif, inclusif et stimulant où chacun peut s’épanouir.
* **Piloter la performance** : développer et optimiser les processus de gestion de la performance pour aligner les objectifs des collaborateurs sur ceux de l’entreprise.
* **Développer les compétences** : piloter les programmes de formation et de développement pour libérer le potentiel et soutenir l’évolution professionnelle.
* **Garantir la conformité** : élaborer et mettre à jour les politiques et processus RH conformément aux standards globaux et aux réglementations locales.
* **Exploiter les données** : utiliser les données et analyses RH pour orienter la prise de décision et améliorer continuellement les processus.

* **Be a true business partner:** Collaborate and work with leaders, employees and all stakeholders (works council, external bodies) to drive all aspects of the employee lifecycle, from recruitment and onboarding to development and retention for a population of around 100 employees.
* **Lead change:** Support organizational growth, workforce planning, and change management initiatives.
* **Champion talent:** Attract, select, and onboard talents to ensure a high\-performing workforce.
* **Shape culture:** Foster a positive, inclusive, and engaging workplace where everyone can thrive.
* **Drive performance:** Drive and enhance performance management processes to align employee goals with company objectives.
* **Empower learning:** Lead training and development programs that unlock potential and support career growth.
* **Ensure compliance:** Develop and update HR policies and processes in line with global standards and local regulations.
* **Leverage data:** Use HR analytics to guide decision\-making and continuously improve processes.

 **Votre profil / Your profile**

  

* Diplôme de niveau Bachelor en Ressources Humaines ou Droit
* Plus de 8 ans d’expérience RH dans un environnement industriel ou de production
* Excellente connaissance du droit du travail français et des bonnes pratiques RH
* Très bonnes compétences en communication, négociation et résolution de problèmes
* Expérience en organisation matricielle et en environnement multiculturel
* Qualités de leadership avec un fort esprit d’équipe et d’autonomisation
* Maîtrise du français et bon niveau d’anglais
* Mobilité pour se rendre sur les différents sites de production
* Excellente maîtrise de MS Office, idéalement SAP SuccessFactors
* Expérience avec des systèmes SIRH (Qualtrics, UKG)
* Aisance dans l’utilisation de l’IA dans la gestion RH au quotidien

  

* Bachelor’s degree in HR or Legal
* 8\+ years of HR experience in an industrial or manufacturing environment
* Strong knowledge of french labor law and HR best practices
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and problem\-solving skills
* Experience in a matrix organization and multicultural environment
* Leadership qualities with a passion for teamwork and empowerment
* Fluency in French and good level of English
* Willingness to travel between production sites
* Excellent knowledge of MS Office, ideally SAP Success Factor
* Experience with HRIS systems (Qualtrics, UKG)
* Savy in using AI in everdays HR life

 **About Oerlikon**

  

Oerlikon is a global innovation powerhouse for surface engineering, polymer processing and additive manufacturing in key industries such as aerospace, automotive, energy, tooling and textiles. We serve as a key partner in enabling our customers to reach their targets for optimizing the performance, function and sustainability of their products and manufacturing processes.  

Our solutions reduce emissions in transportation, maximize longevity and performance of tools, increase energy efficiency and advance intelligent material and sustainable polymer processing. These achievements are proven hallmarks of our global leadership.

  

We at Oerlikon embrace diversity. This is reflected in more than 13,800 employees, representing over 93 nationalities and our presence in more than 38 countries and 207 locations worldwide.

  

Learn more about Oerlikon:  

Be curious \- join Oerlikon  

https://www.oerlikon.com/en/brands/

 **About Oerlikon Luxury**

  

Oerlikon Luxury specializes in producing accessories for the high\-end fashion industry. It comprises two brands: Oerlikon Riri, which produces branded Riri and Cobrax zippers and buttons respectively; and Oerlikon Fineparts, which offers metal components, fashion jewellery and surface treatments.

  

Oerlikon Luxury is headquartered in Mendrisio, Switzerland, counts 1100 employees at 11 sites located in Italy, Switzerland, France and Portugal as well as sales offices in New York, Paris and Shanghai.

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:
**Your Role**
-------------

**In a few words:**


As a Senior QA Automation Engineer at Resilience, you'll be the guardian of quality for our backend services, ensuring that every release meets the highest standards and that our products deliver safe, reliable healthcare solutions to patients.

**How your role contributes to Resilience's success:**


Your work is mission\-critical: by establishing confidence in our releases, mostly through comprehensive backend testing, you'll enable the entire team to ship faster and more safely. You'll be the game\-changer that makes everyone's work easier, protecting patients while accelerating our ability to deliver innovative healthcare solutions.

**What your daily life looks like:**

* Collaborate with developers, product managers, data, and infrastructure teams to ensure timely and high\-quality software releases
* Maintain and enhance automated backend tests across critical data streams such as patient creation, remote monitoring flows.
* Implement backend tests for new back office internal tool.
* Improve and maintain our automated backend testing infrastructure
* Ensure that applications comply with quality management system requirements, including through dealing with related documentation
* Occasionally writing \& executing automated frontend tests and manual tests
* Work closely with QA team members to develop testing strategies for complex healthcare environments

**Your Team**
-------------

**A few words about the members of your team:**


You'll join a strong and motivated QA team that thrives on collaboration and technical excellence. Your teammates are passionate about quality and work together to tackle the challenges of testing in a regulated healthcare environment.

**A few words about your manager:**


Jacob leads with clarity and empathy, understanding both the technical challenges and the human side of working in complex environments. He values flexibility, teamwork, and creates space for his team to grow and excel.

**The little about your team:**


This is a team that doesn't shy away from complexity—they embrace it. They're building something meaningful: testing infrastructure that directly impacts patient safety and healthcare delivery.

**Candidate Profile**
---------------------

**You're the right person if you know how to:**

* Design and implement automated tests, both backend and frontend
* Work with backend technologies and testing frameworks
* Navigate complex technical environments
* Work effectively across multiple teams, build strong technical relationships, and operate in a highly collaborative environment.
* Maintain and improve testing infrastructure
* Ensure compliance with quality management systems in regulated environments
* Read and write English fluently

**You're the right person if you are:**

* An excellent team player who thrives in collaboration
* Flexible and adaptable to changing priorities and technical challenges
* Action\-oriented with strong problem\-solving skills
* Detail\-oriented while keeping the big picture in mind
* Passionate about quality and patient safety

**You're the right person if you have already:**

* Minimum 5 years of experience as a QA Automation Engineer and/or Developer
* Strong technical skills with a backend orientation
* Experience testing complex backend services and APIs
* Working knowledge of CI/CD environments, including GitHub Actions
* Demonstrated expertise with at least one backend test framework (pytest, kotest..) and one front end test framework (Playwright, webdriverio…)
* Demonstrated expertise with at least one scripting language (Typescript, Python…) and one functional language (Java, Kotlin, GoLang, C…)

**It's a if you:**

* Have experience in healthcare or other regulated industries
* Are familiar with medical device quality standards
* Have development experience in addition to QA Automation expertise
* Have excellent oral English skills

**Why join us?**
----------------

* **Make a real impact:** Your work directly helps patients by ensuring the safety and reliability of healthcare services
* **Full remote flexibility:** Work from anywhere while being part of a connected, collaborative team
* **Join a strong team:** Work alongside motivated QA professionals who support each other's growth
* **Tackle meaningful challenges:** Build testing infrastructure that matters in a complex, regulated environment
* **Competitive package:** €65,000 gross annual salary

**Recruitment Process**
-----------------------

**Step 1 \- Hiring Manager Interview (Jacob)**


Duration: 60 minutes \| Focus: General discussion about your background, technical experience, and English proficiency assessment

 **Step 2 \- Technical Skills \& QA Team Fit (Bastien \& Laura)**


Duration: 60 minutes \| Focus: Deep dive into your technical QA skills, backend testing experience, and collaboration with the QA team

 **Step 3 \- Wider Team Fit (Loic)**


Duration: 30 minutes \| Focus: Understanding how you work with cross\-functional teams and contribute to broader product goals

 **Step 4 \- Culture Fit with Talent Manager (Alice)**


Duration: 45 minutes \| Focus: Alignment with Resilience values, work style, and long\-term aspirations

**GDPR** : Your personal data will be processed for the purposes of recruitment related activities, which include setting up and conducting interviews and tests for applicants, evaluating and assessing the results thereto, and as is otherwise needed in the recruitment and hiring processes. They will be available only for people involved in the process and erased after 2 years of inactivity.


Under GDPR and as Resilience attach great importance to privacy, please note that you have the right to request access to your personal data, to request that your personal data be rectified or erased. The Data Protection Officer can be contacted at privacy@resilience.care


For more information, please check our privacy policy.

title: Linux Endpoint Engineer
description:
**About the role**
------------------


Joining Cyberhaven offers a unique opportunity to be at the forefront of revolutionizing data protection through cutting\-edge AI technology. Cyberhaven is dedicated to overcoming the challenges faced by traditional data security products, ensuring robust protection of critical data against insider threats in a rapidly evolving work environment. With a unique approach to data lineage, tracing data from its origin for better classification and protection, Cyberhaven combines the functionality of traditional data protection security tools into a single, more effective solution. This role not only allows you to contribute to the advancement of cloud and data security but also places you within a team of security and product professionals passionate about transforming the way data is protected.


We’re looking for an experienced endpoint systems developer to help drive and evolve our product. Our technology is new and rapidly evolving, and you’ll have a chance to be an early contributor with a substantial impact on the product architecture.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Design and implement components of our state\-of\-the\-art system sensor that traces all data movement across all applications and files on windows endpoints
* Solve challenging performance optimization problems: we’re building software that monitors hundreds of thousands of events with minimal impact on performance of the endpoint applications
* Design and build highly reliable code that never impacts the end\-user experience
* Build secure\-by\-design hardened software that must withstand real\-world attacks, while processing untrusted data and communicating with a backend over the internet

**Who you are**
---------------

* Strong track record in working on security software on Linux using eBPF, kernel modules and audit frameworks.
* Experience with building and maintaining enterprise grade software with support for multiple distributions of Linux.
* Prior work on at least one large native application deployed to tens of thousands of end\-users
* Experience debugging, profiling, and optimizing the performance of low\-level system software
* Experience building endpoint security products, such as DLP or EDR applications
* Proficient in designing and implementing application architecture
* Experience with agile development and SCRUM
* Proven ability to collaborate with a distributed cross\-functional team
* Possess verbal and written communication skills in English
* Availability to frequently communicate with a distributed engineering team in Central European and US Eastern time zones
* Located in the following locations: Bucharest or Cluj, Romania, Bangalore, India,

**What you can count on**
-------------------------

* Competitive salary and stock options
* Excellent benefits such as private health insurance for FTE
* Flexible time off (paid)
* Career advancement opportunities
* Remote\-first


Joining Cyberhaven is a chance to revolutionize data security. Traditional tools fall short, but we’ve reimagined protection with AI\-enabled data lineage that analyzes billions of workflows to understand data, detect risk, and stop threats. Backed by $250M from leading investors like Khosla and Redpoint, our team includes leaders who built industry\-defining technologies at CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Networks, Meta, Google, and more. This role lets you shape the future of data security, alongside experts driven to help customers protect their most valuable information.

*Cyberhaven is committed to creating a diverse environment and is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.*

title: Infrastructure Engineering Manager
description:
**About Engineering at Botify**
-------------------------------


At Botify, our Engineering team builds and scales the technologies that help the world’s largest websites improve their visibility in Search Engines or AI search results. We tackle complex challenges—like crawling, rendering, and indexing websites with millions of pages—while analyzing and combining diverse datasets. Our goal is to make it easier for users to implement effective SEO strategies through powerful, reliable, and easy\-to\-use tools.


Our platform analyses and delivers data at a rare scale. Every day, we process over 600,000 tasks, consuming more than 500 instances, and maintain a database with over 17 billion lines. We render 150 million web pages daily and serve 100 million pages to search engine bots, powered by a hybrid architecture combining cloud and bare\-metal systems to balance performance with cost efficiency.


We are actively developing agentic tools to streamline Botify usage and equip every user with advanced technical skills, enabling them to navigate tehnical tasks with ease. Our platform integrates multiple datasets from technical SEO, search engine crawls, user visits, and search engine rankings, providing automated recommendations, alerts, and optimizations such as pre\-redening, content enhancement and linking improvements.


In the Engineering Department, we foster a culture that empowers engineers with the freedom to innovate. This autonomy is balanced with a strong sense of responsibility and a commitment to excellence. Our team thrives on collaboration and cross\-functional cooperation, promoting a consultative approach over traditional top\-down management. This environment encourages open communication and collective problem\-solving, driving our success and continuous improvement.


If you’re looking for a place where your work has strong impact, and where your voice matters, we’d love to discuss with you.

**About Infra at Botify**
-------------------------


Our infrastructure team, currently of 3 engineers, is looking for a hands\-on technical leader to lead the infrastructure team, carve with them the infra roadmap and participate in the success of the engineering projects by creating new infrastructures or improving and maintaining existing ones.


Our team is responsible for the entire infrastructure and enables Botify frontend and backend stacks to run in production. We always take the initiative to improve our stack or workaround recurring problems. We support the other engineering teams (55\+ persons) as needed, provide staging/sandbox environments, and participate in architecture decisions. We are involved in code reviews (both for infrastructure and platform code) and can suggest or contribute to app changes.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

**Why this job is for you**:


You enjoy team leadership without giving up hands\-on technical work. You are a player\-coach: comfortable guiding a team while remaining close to systems, code, and operations.


You currently work within the Infrastructure or DevOps team of a startup/scaleup or tech company.


You know the DevOps philosophy and practice infrastructure as code.


You like when the platform is up, when operations are smooth and automated, when metrics and errors flow automatically to the right persons and alert you if something goes south.


You take initiatives to make our operations better and communicate with the rest of the tech team at the right level.

### **Your responsibilities:**


You will spend 25% of your time in team management, 50% contributing to technical improvements and 25% on the run part.


You will define and communicate the infra roadmap, prioritize projects, follow all infra projects and guarantee their success, create new infrastructures or iterate on existing ones, either on projects led by the infra team, or on projects co\-driven by development squads.


You will be the go\-to person for the development team when they have questions on the infrastructure or need help on the parts of the infrastructure they are building.


You will work closely with the Security team, participating in the Security committees to bring clarification on infrastructure choices and make possible the security approvals. You will participate in our yearly SOC2 audits, organizing the gathering of proofs of compliance for the infrastructure requests and and answering our auditors' questions.


You actively monitor infra costs and take initiatives to either lower them or at least not allow them to grow.


Annually, you prepare the infra budget for the next year, including the needed budget for the platform and for all our collective internal tools.


We explained parts of our infrastructures in this podcast (in french): Link

### **Your qualification:**

* You have 8\+ years of Infrastructure/cloud DevOps experience.
* You have a first experience in team management, including demonstrated leadership skills, capacity to lead a motivating vision and to include the team in the discussions to build a roadmap, and appetite for cross\-teams discussions with the developer squads.
* You have strong experience working with cloud providers like AWS/GCP, ideally both, but it can be one or the other.
* You have experience managing mission critical platforms (SLA 99\.5%\+) and/or experience on a data processing platform.
* You use IaC tools like Terraform or Ansible.
* You work with a high level scripting language (ideally Python).
* You have good knowledge of the Unix platform and ecosystem (we use Ubuntu internally, but it's not a requirement).
* General knowledge of CDN behaviors. Understanding configuration is a plus.
* You have professional proficiency in English and French.

**Technical stack:**

* A mix of AWS, GCP and OVH (bare\-metal).
* Docker and our internal deployment system.
* Ansible for our instance configuration and Terraform (\+terragrunt) for the infrastructure configuration.
* 1500\+ servers, scaling depending on the workload.
* Load of 2000 req/s on some services.

title: Senior Product Analyst - Growth (all genders)
description:
JustPlay is looking for a Senior Product Analyst to join the team. You’ll work alongside our cross\-functional Growth team, which focuses on onboarding players to the platform, ensuring they enjoy a happy first experience that encourages them to become loyal players. You will work with the team to provide actionable insights that shape product decisions and create exceptional first experiences for our players.  

We're looking for someone who's naturally curious about both the technical challenges of data analysis and the business questions that drive our product strategy. You should be self\-driven and proactive, think creatively when solving problems, and have a genuine curiosity to understand player behavior beyond the metrics.

**Job requirements**
--------------------

* At least 5 years of experience in an analytics role, preferably in product analytics focusing on consumer\-facing products, including funnel analysis. Experience analysing first time user experience is a plus
* Proficient in SQL and Python, including packages such as Pandas and Numpy
* Experience with collaborative analysis environments such as Google Colab or Jupyter notebooks
* Experience planning, conducting and analyzing A/B tests, with understanding of statistical significance, hypothesis testing, and experimentation best practices
* Experience designing and overseeing the implementation of tracking specifications
* Experience defining and implementing metrics and building clear and beautiful visualisations using BI platforms such as Looker, Tableau, or Metabase
* Experience conducting complex correlational analysis such as stickiness analysis, churn analysis and detection, VIP analysis
* Hands\-on experience with data warehouses such as BigQuery or Snowflake
* Familiar with mobile analytics platforms (e.g., Adjust, Amplitude, Firebase) for measuring user acquisition and engagement
* Comfortable conducting statistical analysis and modeling using statistical best practices
* Strong attention to detail and ability to interpret complex data
* Excellent communication skills and proven experience collaborating with business stakeholders

**This job is not for you if**

* You don’t mind doing analyses whose results will be ignored
* You enjoy repetitive tasks that do not require you to think or be creative
* You don’t care about business goals and measuring impact
* It doesn’t bother you to build tools that no one will use
* You’re comfortable using methods without understanding the science behind them
* You don’t like solving complex problems
* You are not looking for an environment that challenges you
* You don’t ask challenging questions


But if you're passionate about creating exceptional first experiences through data, love working in cross\-functional teams, and thrive on driving measurable impact \- we want to hear from you!

**Job responsibilities**
------------------------

* Investigate, map, quantify and visualise our users’ early experiences
* Conduct early churn analysis and investigate early churn drivers
* Deep dive into user behaviour data to unearth usage patterns and motivations, and influence product roadmap based on these
* Work closely with product managers, designers, and developers to translate findings into actionable recommendations that improve our KPIs
* Develop and evolve tracking concepts to ensure we collect accurate, reliable and actionable data. Define metrics and build reporting and visualisations that provide clear and accurate data to business stakeholders
* Plan, define, conduct and evaluate A/B tests and drive experimentation\-led Product development. Manage the testing roadmap
* Promote data literacy and advocate for data usage and data driven decision making
* Think creatively to find optimal solutions to complex unstructured problems
* Use Machine Learning algorithms for tasks such as user segmentation, regression and classification
* Work closely with our Data Engineering and Analytics teams to improve our data products, all leading to quicker and accurate outcomes
* Collaborate with our Engineering teams to define the data that we need to collect to get the best outcomes

**Job benefits**
----------------

* **Work\-Life Balance and Flexibility:** Flexible working hours and options for digital nomads, occasional office visitors, or regular office\-goers
* **Employee Stock Options:** Opportunity to join our Virtual Share Option Program (VSOP) and share in the success of an already profitable company
* **Mental Health Support:** Free personal coaching through our partner nilo.health to support our team members to live fulfilled lives at home and at work
* **Training \& Development:** A competitive personal development budget of up to 2000€/year for training, conferences, workshops, etc., and free language courses with Chatterbug
* **Germany\-Based Benefits:** 25 vacation days, free Gympass gold subscription, free monthly Deutschland\-Ticket, and a monthly €50 tax\-free internet contribution
* **State\-of\-the\-Art Equipment:** Doesn’t matter if you are a MacBook or Windows user; we will provide you with the technical gear you need to succeed
* **A Relocation Package:** Includes visa support for those who need it
* **Berlin Office Perks:** Ergonomic setup, free daily lunch, and a dog\-friendly environment.
* **Engaging and Diverse Work Environment:** Join a diverse team, with over 30 nationalities working from 20 different locations
* *Benefits may vary depending on location and contract type. Do not hesitate to ask us about more details on our benefits offer.*

**About us**
------------

  

Come join the team building the engine behind rewarded mobile gaming \- making playtime truly rewarding. At JustPlay, we’re on a mission to power a fairer, more sustainable Play\-to\-Earn ecosystem where players earn real value for their time, funded through a self\-sustaining loop.


Since launching in 2020, we’ve grown into one of the world’s leading loyalty gaming platforms, with 25M\+ downloads and 500K\+ daily active users. Bootstrapped and headquartered in Berlin, we own and operate the full stack: the JustPlay app, adtech monetization, first\-party games, and automated payouts. With a team across 20\+ countries.


We’re helping shape a major shift in mobile gaming and it’s still early enough for you to make your mark. At JustPlay, you’ll have the freedom and ownership to build end to end, move with startup speed backed by veteran leadership, and ship work that reaches millions \- in a company that’s profitable, built to last, and focused on outcomes over hype.

title: AI Automation Engineering
description:
**About GitGuardian**
---------------------


GitGuardian is a global post\-Series B cybersecurity scale\-up, with team members in France, Europe and in the USA.


Among our early investors who saw our market value proposition, are the **co\-founder of GitHub, Scott Chacon,** along with **Solomon Hykes**, **Docker's co\-founder.** American and European top\-tier VC firms have also invested in GitGuardian.


GitGuardian leads the way in Non\-Human Identity security, offering end\-to\-end solutions from secrets detection in code, productivity tools and environments to strong remediation, observability and proactive prevention of leaks. We’re applying the same ambition internally by building an AI\-powered operating model—using agents, automation, and data to run GitGuardian faster and smarter every day.


Our solutions are already used by more than 600K developers worldwide!

**About your team and your mission**
------------------------------------


As our first dedicated AI Automation Engineer, you will be a foundational part of our data team's expansion. You will join a core team of 3 Data Engineers, and will be one of two new dedicated roles (alongside an Analytics Engineer) being added to build out our advanced data capabilities. You will be pivotal to GitGuardian's growth and success by establishing and leading our internal AI and automation function, acting as a force multiplier for the entire company.


You will design, build, and deploy an internal AI platform—automations, agents, and data\-driven workflows—that other teams adopt and extend. You’ll sit at the crossroads of Business Process, AI Application, and Data, directly improving how GitGuardian operates at scale.

**Your main responsibilities will be to:**

* Design and Build Business Automations: Identify, design, and implement robust workflows connecting systems (HubSpot, Notion, Linear) to eliminate manual processes using n8n or Python.
* Build Internal Apps \& Agents: Develop Dust\-powered agents and wrap them in lightweight interfaces (simple UIs, CLIs, or chat) for self\-serve usage and strong adoption.
* Fuel with Data: Partner with Analytics and Data Engineers to leverage trusted models and pipelines—ensuring quality, observability, and fast iteration.
* Strategic Partner: Proactively map processes, spot high\-impact opportunities, and translate needs into scalable, user\-friendly solutions.
* Centre of Excellence: Set paved paths, best practices, and manage our AI \& Automation tooling (Dust, n8n) to enable teams to ship safely and fast.
* Own the Lifecycle: Discovery to production, documentation, enablement, monitoring, and iterative improvement focused on reliability, UX, and adoption.
* Stay at the Forefront: Bring pragmatic innovation from agentic workflows, retrieval, and evaluation into production—not just experiments.

**Technical Environment**

* Core Languages: Python, SQL
* AI: Dust, LangChain
* Automation: n8n
* Data Warehouse: Snowflake
* Orchestration \& Deployment: Dagster, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform
* Data Ingestion: Fivetran, Airbyte, custom scripts
* Data Sources: PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, various APIs (Hubspot, Notion, etc.)

**About you**
-------------

*If you think you match at least 70% of these criteria, please apply!*


Here's what we consider essential for success in this role:

* 5\+ years in a technical or solutions role (Analytics Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Data Analysis, or technical Business Ops) with a track record of production automations or tools.
* Python expert for APIs, data manipulation, and robust scripts/apps.
* Hands\-on with Generative AI (Dust, RAG, agentic workflows, prompt engineering).
* Pragmatic: use no/low\-code (n8n/Zapier/Make) when fastest; drop to Python when it matters.
* Product mindset for internal tooling: intuitive interfaces, clear UX, adoption across non\-technical teams.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication; collaborate across technical and non\-technical teams.
* Familiar with data warehousing (Snowflake) and SQL to fuel automations.


The following skills would strengthen your application but aren't required:

* Previous experience in a high\-growth B2B SaaS company.
* Experience building lightweight internal UIs or CLIs to package automations/AI agents (e.g., simple web apps or chat interfaces).
* Experience with our specific Data stack (Dagster, Fivetran/Airbyte, Metabase).
* Familiarity with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).

**The interview process**
-------------------------

*At GitGuardian, we are committed to building a diverse, equitable and inclusive workforce.*

*We will ask for your gender identity on the application page to help us understand the diversity of our applicant pool and to track our progress in attracting and hiring a diverse workforce. The information is optional and will not be disclosed to the hiring manager or the interview team and will not be considered in the hiring process. We appreciate your willingness to share this with us so that we can continue to improve our diversity, equity and inclusion efforts.*

**1\. Interview with your future manager**

*To know more about yourself, your professional experiences and your motivations. Also to assess end\-to\-end delivery of automations/agents; stakeholder communication; pragmatic tool choice (no/low\-code vs. Python); familiarity with Dust/LLM platforms.*

**3\. Technical interview**

*To evaluate your skills for the position and project yourself into the role. We will assess practical automation engineering, AI agent design, and data integration.*

**4\.1 Final interview with an Executive Manager**

*To detail our company’s vision and ambitions for the next couple of years. We will assess your product mindset, change management, and enablement of non\-technical users.*

**4\.2 References check**

*You can start thinking about two contacts who can attest to your previous or current professional experiences. These contacts should be as recent as possible, and we will call them at the end of the process.*

**Benefits**
------------

* Package that includes stock\-options
* Lunch voucher (Swile)
* Non\-charged health insurance for children (Sidecare / Generali)
* Up to €300 to improve your home office set\-up
* Yearly holiday allowance
* Referral bonus of 4000€ for any new Guardian we might hire thanks to you
* Team building: monthly budget dedicated to each employee that you can spend as you wish, with colleagues (latest examples to date: Michelin star restaurant, karaoke, stand\-up show, kitesurfing week\-end, ...)


And also...

* Remote policy: hybrid (2 days/week at the office)
* Opportunities for career development in the long term

**More about GitGuardian!**
---------------------------

**Products**

* Understand how GitGuardian works in this short video!
* Want to go even further? Check out our public roadmap!
* Check out the State of Secrets Sprawl Report to understand our mission and the industry.
* Our solutions are already used by hundreds of thousands of developers in all industries and **GitGuardian platform is the n°1 app on the** GitHub marketplace

**Clients**

* GitGuardian helps organizations find exposed sensitive information that could often lead to tens of millions of dollars in potential damage.
* More than 70% of our customers are in the United States.
* Many F500 companies use GitGuardian's platform.

**People**

* The Guardians are **knowledgeable**, committed, serious, **aligned with the company’s mission, and true team players**: always willing to help each other grow our skill sets!
* The team is diverse and we hail from more than 20 different countries.
* We are also **agile, remote\-friendly,** and **fun people** to work with.
* You will get **trust \& autonomy** on your perimeter with a very **transparent internal communication** and a strong impact on the company development.

Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. Read more about it here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1tzxGX4Uu7Ts\_HCLFXESKLnKaaBfVCPf1f9AYZPrkjJM/preview?tab\=t.0
